test.create_query: CREATE TABLE enc_num ( CounterID UInt32, EventDate Date, t_lz4 DateTime CODEC(LZ4), u_lz4 UInt64 CODEC(LZ4), t_zstd DateTime DEFAULT t_lz4 CODEC(ZSTD(1)), u_zstd UInt64 DEFAULT u_lz4 CODEC(ZSTD(1)), t_dd DateTime DEFAULT t_lz4 CODEC(DoubleDelta), u_dd UInt64 DEFAULT u_lz4 CODEC(DoubleDelta), t_t64 DateTime DEFAULT t_lz4 CODEC(T64, LZ4), u_t64 UInt64 DEFAULT u_lz4 CODEC(T64, LZ4), MobilePhoneModel LowCardinality(String), SearchPhrase LowCardinality(String), URL LowCardinality(String) ) ENGINE = MergeTree PARTITION BY intHash32(u_lz4) % 16 ORDER BY (CounterID, EventDate, intHash32(u_lz4), t_lz4, u_lz4, MobilePhoneModel, SearchPhrase, URL) SETTINGS old_parts_lifetime = 10
CREATE TABLE enc_url (url_lz4 String CODEC(LZ4), url_zstd String DEFAULT url_lz4 CODEC(ZSTD(1)), url_lc LowCardinality(String) DEFAULT url_lz4) ENGINE = MergeTree ORDER BY tuple()
CREATE TABLE enc_w_num_none (t DateTime CODEC(NONE), u UInt64 CODEC(NONE)) ENGINE = MergeTree ORDER BY tuple() SETTINGS old_parts_lifetime = 0
CREATE TABLE enc_w_num_lz4 (t DateTime CODEC(LZ4), u UInt64 CODEC(LZ4)) ENGINE = MergeTree ORDER BY tuple() SETTINGS old_parts_lifetime = 0
CREATE TABLE enc_w_num_zstd (t DateTime CODEC(ZSTD(1)), u UInt64 CODEC(ZSTD(1))) ENGINE = MergeTree ORDER BY tuple() SETTINGS old_parts_lifetime = 0
CREATE TABLE enc_w_num_dd (t DateTime CODEC(DoubleDelta), u UInt64 CODEC(DoubleDelta)) ENGINE = MergeTree ORDER BY tuple() SETTINGS old_parts_lifetime = 0
CREATE TABLE enc_w_num_t64 (t DateTime CODEC(T64, LZ4), u UInt64 CODEC(T64, LZ4)) ENGINE = MergeTree ORDER BY tuple() SETTINGS old_parts_lifetime = 0
CREATE TABLE enc_w_url_lz4 (url String CODEC(LZ4)) ENGINE = MergeTree ORDER BY tuple() SETTINGS old_parts_lifetime = 0
CREATE TABLE enc_w_url_zstd (url String CODEC(ZSTD(1))) ENGINE = MergeTree ORDER BY tuple() SETTINGS old_parts_lifetime = 0
CREATE TABLE enc_w_url_lc (url LowCardinality(String)) ENGINE = MergeTree ORDER BY tuple() SETTINGS old_parts_lifetime = 0
test.fill_query: INSERT INTO enc_num (CounterID, EventDate, t_lz4, u_lz4, MobilePhoneModel, SearchPhrase, URL) SELECT CounterID, EventDate, EventTime, UserID, MobilePhoneModel, SearchPhrase, URL FROM hits_100m_single SETTINGS max_insert_threads = 16
OPTIMIZE TABLE enc_num FINAL SETTINGS optimize_throw_if_noop = 1, optimize_skip_merged_partitions = 1
INSERT INTO enc_url (url_lz4) SELECT URL FROM hits_10m_single SETTINGS max_threads = 1, max_insert_threads = 1, min_insert_block_size_rows = 20000000, min_insert_block_size_bytes = 0
INSERT INTO enc_w_num_{w_codec} SELECT EventTime, UserID FROM hits_10m_single SETTINGS max_threads = 1, max_insert_threads = 1, min_insert_block_size_rows = 20000000, min_insert_block_size_bytes = 0

INSERT INTO enc_w_url_{url_enc} SELECT URL FROM hits_10m_single WHERE CounterID < 57 SETTINGS max_threads = 1, max_insert_threads = 1, min_insert_block_size_rows = 20000000, min_insert_block_size_bytes = 0
SELECT throwIf(count() != 16 OR sum(rows) != 100000000) FROM system.parts WHERE database = 'default' AND table = 'enc_num' AND active

SELECT throwIf(count() != 9 OR countIf(table = 'enc_url' AND rows = 10000000) != 1 OR countIf(table LIKE 'enc\_w\_num\_%' AND rows = 10000000) != 5 OR countIf(table LIKE 'enc\_w\_url\_%' AND rows = 2331397) != 3) FROM system.parts WHERE database = 'default' AND (table = 'enc_url' OR table LIKE 'enc\_w\_%') AND active

SELECT throwIf(arraySort(groupArray(concat(table, '.', name, ' ', type, ' ', compression_codec))) != [ 'enc_w_num_dd.t DateTime CODEC(DoubleDelta)', 'enc_w_num_dd.u UInt64 CODEC(DoubleDelta)', 'enc_w_num_lz4.t DateTime CODEC(LZ4)', 'enc_w_num_lz4.u UInt64 CODEC(LZ4)', 'enc_w_num_none.t DateTime CODEC(NONE)', 'enc_w_num_none.u UInt64 CODEC(NONE)', 'enc_w_num_t64.t DateTime CODEC(T64, LZ4)', 'enc_w_num_t64.u UInt64 CODEC(T64, LZ4)', 'enc_w_num_zstd.t DateTime CODEC(ZSTD(1))', 'enc_w_num_zstd.u UInt64 CODEC(ZSTD(1))', 'enc_w_url_lc.url LowCardinality(String) ', 'enc_w_url_lz4.url String CODEC(LZ4)', 'enc_w_url_zstd.url String CODEC(ZSTD(1))']) FROM system.columns WHERE database = 'default' AND table LIKE 'enc\_w\_%'
SELECT throwIf(countIf(NOT (t_zstd = t_lz4 AND t_dd = t_lz4 AND t_t64 = t_lz4 AND u_zstd = u_lz4 AND u_dd = u_lz4 AND u_t64 = u_lz4)) != 0) FROM enc_num

SELECT throwIf((SELECT sum(cityHash64(CounterID, EventDate, t_lz4, u_lz4, MobilePhoneModel, SearchPhrase, URL)) FROM enc_num) != (SELECT sum(cityHash64(CounterID, EventDate, EventTime, UserID, MobilePhoneModel, SearchPhrase, URL)) FROM hits_100m_single))
SELECT throwIf(countIf(NOT (url_zstd = url_lz4 AND url_lc = url_lz4)) != 0 OR sum(cityHash64(url_lz4)) != (SELECT sum(cityHash64(URL)) FROM hits_10m_single)) FROM enc_url
SELECT throwIf((SELECT sum(cityHash64(t, u)) FROM enc_w_num_{w_codec}) != (SELECT sum(cityHash64(EventTime, UserID)) FROM hits_10m_single))
SELECT throwIf((SELECT sum(cityHash64(url)) FROM enc_w_url_{url_enc}) != (SELECT sum(cityHash64(URL)) FROM hits_10m_single WHERE CounterID < 57))

SELECT throwIf((SELECT sum(cityHash64(m, c)) FROM (SELECT lower(MobilePhoneModel) AS m, count() AS c FROM enc_num GROUP BY m)) != (SELECT sum(cityHash64(m, c)) FROM (SELECT lower(MobilePhoneModel) AS m, count() AS c FROM hits_100m_single GROUP BY m)))

SELECT throwIf((SELECT groupArray(cityHash64(SearchPhrase, c)) FROM (SELECT SearchPhrase, count() AS c FROM enc_num WHERE SearchPhrase != '' GROUP BY SearchPhrase ORDER BY c DESC, SearchPhrase LIMIT 10)) != (SELECT groupArray(cityHash64(SearchPhrase, c)) FROM (SELECT SearchPhrase, count() AS c FROM hits_100m_single WHERE SearchPhrase != '' GROUP BY SearchPhrase ORDER BY c DESC, SearchPhrase LIMIT 10)))

SELECT throwIf((SELECT groupArray(cityHash64(URL, c)) FROM (SELECT URL, count() AS c FROM enc_num GROUP BY URL ORDER BY c DESC, URL LIMIT 10)) != (SELECT groupArray(cityHash64(URL, c)) FROM (SELECT URL, count() AS c FROM hits_100m_single GROUP BY URL ORDER BY c DESC, URL LIMIT 10)))
test.query: SELECT t_{codec}, u_{codec} FROM enc_num FORMAT Null SETTINGS max_threads = 1
SELECT url_{url_enc} FROM enc_url FORMAT Null SETTINGS max_threads = 1
SELECT lower(MobilePhoneModel) AS m, count() AS c FROM enc_num GROUP BY m FORMAT Null SETTINGS max_threads = 1
SELECT SearchPhrase, count() AS c FROM enc_num WHERE SearchPhrase != '' GROUP BY SearchPhrase ORDER BY c DESC, SearchPhrase LIMIT 10 FORMAT Null
SELECT URL, count() AS c FROM enc_num GROUP BY URL ORDER BY c DESC, URL LIMIT 10 FORMAT Null
